summary: Strengthened AGENT_SYSTEM prompt to explicitly instruct the agent to challenge negative VQA consensus when targeted inspection tools fail, directing it to re-examine original pixels for subtle abnormalities.

edits.hypothesis: Adding explicit instructions to challenge negative VQA consensus when targeted tools (like roi_crop) fail will prevent the agent from uncritically accepting false negatives, addressing the primary failure mode in q000001, q000004, and q000005.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The failure is behavioral: the agent has the image but chooses to trust the VQA output over its own visual inspection when the 'helper' tool fails. This requires a strong directive in the system prompt to override the default trust in model outputs.
edits.trigger_condition: always (applies to all M5 agent executions)
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001/q000005, the agent would have been instructed to ignore the failed crop and actively look for subtle signs in the full image instead of accepting the 'normal' VQA output. In q000004, it would have challenged the 'Pneumonia' consensus by looking for nodule features. (preservative) Success cases like q000003/q000007 where no tools were needed or tools succeeded are unaffected as the instruction only activates on failure/disagreement context. (transfer) Generalizes to any task where a specific inspection tool fails but the general model provides a potentially misleading negative.
edits.regression_risk: May cause the agent to spend more steps re-examining images in ambiguous cases, but this is preferred over incorrect answers. No risk of breaking valid positive findings.
edits.mechanism: Adding explicit instructions to challenge negative VQA consensus when targeted tools (like roi_crop) fail will prevent the agent from uncritically accepting false negatives, addressing the primary failure mode in q000001, q000004, and q000005.
